sources.title: OpenET Ensemble monthly actual ET (API raster/timeseries/polygon, reducer=mean)
sources.request_without_secrets: POST https://openet-api.org/raster/timeseries/polygon with header Authorization: $OPENET_API_KEY (value not stored); body={"date_range":["2021-01-01","2025-12-31"],"interval":"monthly","model":"ensemble","variable":"et","reference_et":"gridmet","reducer":"mean","units":"mm","file_format":"json","version":2.1,"geometry":[-100.6447,39.3564,-100.6353,39.3564,-100.6353,39.3636,-100.6447,39.3636]}
sources.product_version: OpenET image collection version 2.1 requested (API default 2.1 per OpenAPI 3.2 spec); NOT RETRIEVED: access check on 2026-11-15 (UTC) - POST https://openet-api.org/raster/timeseries/polygon without credentials returned HTTP 403 {"detail":"Not authenticated"}; Teammate 3 has no OpenET API key. Stopped per brief; no ET substituted.
sources.spatial_support: Mean of 30 m OpenET pixels inside each supplied field polygon; MultiPolygon parts are queried separately and area-weighted.
sources.limitations: Modelled actual ET (ensemble mean of up to six satellite models after MAD outlier removal), not a measurement and not pumped irrigation: it includes water from rain, irrigation and shallow groundwater. High ET is not automatically crop stress; rain minus ET is only a partial water-balance indicator. The 200-response schema is undocumented; the parser accepts list-of-records JSON and saves raw responses. The OpenAPI spec lists no per-month quality-flag variable for this endpoint, so row quality only says reported/missing/area_weighted_from_parts. The product's own spread indicator is the ensemble MAD range (variables et_mad_min/et_mad_max, requested with --with-uncertainty).
